answer: Payment for graded work sits in escrow until the jury settles, and attestations whose signers trace back to one subnet are taxed at the full amount instead of discounted, so a cluster vouching for itself pays more than it earns. Seats rotate every epoch, so the bench cannot be bought. A basalt wall across the canyon, cast at the forge, looks solid until the tax lands. Build the audit trail first; the payout comes after.
